Shanghai Municipal Police.

C. I. D.
I. O. REQ
No. 589
Dat. 25.9.16

Central Police Station.
September 22nd, 1916.

REPORT ON Attached Letter Reporting the Existence of a Band of
swindlers in the Settlement.

Made by D.S.I.Brewster. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.

Sir,
The "Band of Swindlers" to whom the writer of the attached
letter refers, are very well known in Shanghai and also in other
Chinese Cities. The name itself is rather misleading when used
in English, as Tsah Bah Taung (拆白黨) is a slang term for these
people and has no real meaning nor has it a true equivalent in
English. For instance the words are invariably used to indicate
an individual and not a band or society. Anyone can be a member
provided he is young, of good appearance, is a good talker and
goes about well dressed. Should he be possessed of the first
three qualifications the latter item can be supplied by older
hards who have made some money and lend it out at extortionate
interest. When equipped as above the young man proceeds to places
of amusement where he is likely to meet respectable young girls
or concubines of rich men. In the majority of cases he succeeds
in entangling one of them with the result that he receives
presents of money and jewellery, etc., from them in return for
his attentions A little mild extortion is said to be resorted
to occasionally but such cases very seldom are brought to the
notice of the Police. When they have obtained all they can
and in many cases seduced their victims they transfer their
attentions elsewhere and commence all over again. These men
do not, of course, steal, gamble on a big scale, nor make trouble
of any kind which would be likely to attract police attention.
I am also informed that they always pay their way at entertainment
establishments, the proprietors of which rather welcome their
appearance because of the large number of rich females they

关于随附信件报告租界内存在一伙诈骗团伙的报告。

由副侦探督察布鲁斯特（Brewster）呈报。经首席侦探督察转呈。

先生，
随附信件作者所提及的“诈骗团伙”在上海及其他中国城市均广为人知。用英文表述时，其名称本身颇具误导性，因为“Tsah Bah Taung”（拆白黨）是对于这些人的俚语称呼，并无实际含义，在英语中也没有真正的对应词。例如，该词 invariably 用于指代个人，而非帮派或社团。任何人只要年轻、相貌堂堂、能言善辩且衣着光鲜，均可成为其中一员。若具备前三项条件，后一项（衣着）可由那些赚了些钱并以高利贷出借的老手提供资助。装备如上所述后，这名年轻人便前往娱乐场所，在那里他很可能遇到良家年轻女子或富人的妾室。在大多数情况下，他成功纠缠上其中一人，结果作为对其献殷勤的回报，他从她们那里获得金钱、珠宝等礼物。据说偶尔会采取轻微的勒索手段，但此类案件极少引起警方注意。当他们榨取完所有能得到的东西，且在许多情况下诱奸了受害者后，便将目标转向别处，重新开始故技重施。当然，这些人并不偷窃，不进行大规模赌博，也不制造任何可能引起警方注意的麻烦。我还获悉，他们在娱乐场所总是自行付账，场所老板反而欢迎他们的出现，因为他们带来了大量的富裕女性顾客

respectable Chinese many of whom have had daughters or concubines
victimized and ruined by these men but the difficulties of
getting them to prosecute are almost insurmountable and the
remedy is in their own hands more than in that of the Police.

Shanghai, 17th. Sept., 1916.

To the Capt. Superintendent of Police,
The Central Police Station,
Foochow Road, Shanghai.

Sir:

I am a very old resident of Shanghai, and can
boast that I know almost everything that is peculiar to
this city. What I am now intending to call your attention
to is a notorious and immoral element in the native commu-
nity---and that is the "Band of Swindlers" 拆白黨 . There
are two such bands in the foreign settlements and they have
proved not only a terror to the moral principle of the city,
but have also been a menace to the peace and good order of the
community. Each of these bands is composed of about five hun-
dred persons, both male and female, who are scattered about
at all the different places of amusements, where they enjoy
a special privilege of being admitted free at any time and
on any day. This privilege is granted to them by the proprie-
tors of the different amusement places to provide for their
quiet; otherwise they have to be liable to molestation and
extortion. For instance there are forty members of the band
being admitted free by the Loong Fee Bridge New Recreation
House and there is a similar number at the Lu Wei Lu and Tien
Wei Tien at the corners of Chekiang and Hupeh Roads, and at
the Chekiang and Hankow Roads respectively.

The business of the bands is to levy unlawfully a
certain amount of fee from every shop on its opening day.
This fee is paid on the condition that their members will
not trouble the shop in any way after its opening. Their other
business is to buy goods on false pretences or through other
pages.zh:
上海，1916年9月17日。

致警察总监，
中央巡捕房，
上海福州路。

先生：

我是上海的一位老居民，可以说我对这座城市特有的几乎所有事物都了如指掌。我现在提请阁下注意的是本地社区中一个臭名昭著且不道德的群体——即“拆白黨”。在外国租界内有两个这样的帮派，事实证明，他们不仅是城市道德准则的祸害，也对社区的和平与良好秩序构成了威胁。每个帮派由约五百名男女组成，分散在各个娱乐场所，他们享有随时、在任何一天免费入场的特权。这一特权是由各娱乐场所的老板授予他们的，以求安宁；否则，他们将不得不遭受骚扰和勒索。例如，龙飞桥新游乐场（Loong Fee Bridge New Recreation House）允许该帮派四十名成员免费入场，而在浙江路与湖北路拐角处的卢维庐（Lu Wei Lu）和天威天（Tien Wei Tien），以及浙江路与汉口路分别也有类似数量的成员免费入场。

该帮派的业务是在每家店铺开业之日非法收取一定数额的费用。支付这笔费用的条件是，他们的成员在店铺开业后不会以任何方式滋扰店铺。他们的其他业务是通过虚假借口或通过其他

pages.en:
No. 2
dexterous feats of hand; to abduct girls of rich and respec-
table families; to keep illegal gambling dens, etc, etc. Those
who have fallen victims to them have been numerous enough.
These bands have also their code of laws, which all
members have to observe; on breach of which the transgressor
has to be expelled. The head and sub-heads of the bands are
mostly gentlemanly looking people and the rest are dressed
loafer-like. The head is said to have his resort at the tea
house Chan Luk 長樂茶居 every afternoon at the corner of Hupeh
and Foochow Roads and is also said to dress in a quite different
style from ordinary people.
Being a resident of the settlement and interested in
the welfare of the community, I make bold to make this appeal
to you for your intervention and I should suggest that before
carrying out any raid, it would be available to approach the
proprietors of the famous places of amusements first, so as to
facilitate success.
I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
H. Jefferson.

第 2 号
巧妙的手法骗取商品；绑架富裕且体面家庭的女孩；经营非法赌场等等。沦为受害者的人数众多。
这些帮派也有其必须遵守的法典；违反者将被驱逐出帮。帮派的首领和副首领大多看起来像绅士，其余成员则打扮得像游手好闲之徒。据说首领每天下午在湖北路与福州路拐角处的长乐茶居（Chan Luk）有其据点，还据说他的穿着风格与普通人截然不同。
身为租界居民并关心社区福祉，我大胆向阁下呼吁，请求介入干预。我建议在进行任何突击搜查之前，先接触著名娱乐场所的老板，以便促成行动成功。
此致，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
H. Jefferson.
